canonicalEvidence.note: Continue from automation24; Sep-1 BNetzA CI artifact remains the canonical prefix denominator.

deferred.missing: AVIA's official Ladetarif page explicitly accepts an EVSE-ID and returns the current AVIA Volt Dynamic tariff, blocking fee and start price. The tariff is therefore EVSE/dynamic rather than a safe network-wide fallback. Public Mobilithek-derived station evidence currently shows 0.79 EUR/kWh on several DE*APS HPC points, but that value is not promoted prefix-wide because the official lookup is dynamic.
deferred.unblock: Implement a reproducible public EVSE lookup collector against the official AVIA tariff flow, or ingest exact AFIR/Mobilithek price components per DE*APS EVSE; leave unmatched EVSE unranked.

deferred.missing: Current Eco-Movement/Mobilithek-derived station evidence exposes exact prices per DE*POW EVSE and demonstrates connector/site-specific values (for example 0.44 EUR/kWh AC and 0.66 EUR/kWh DC at multiple sites). No primary MOON POWER source establishing these as a universal Germany-wide tariff was found, so prefix-wide inference is forbidden.
deferred.unblock: Collect exact Mobilithek/DATEX II price components for all DE*POW EVSE or obtain a current official MOON POWER tariff contract that proves universal scope; unknown EVSE remain unranked.

deferred.missing: DE*MSU is a shared technical/platform prefix used by many different physical operators (examples include Stadtwerke Parchim, Stadtwerke Delitzsch, Städtische Werke Spremberg, Stadtwerke Blankenburg, Energieversorgung Guben and private operators). A single CPO-wide tariff is structurally invalid. Public msu/m8mit pages resolve the physical operator per EVSE and Mobilithek-derived records can expose station-specific price components.
deferred.unblock: Resolve each DE*MSU EVSE to its physical operator and ingest exact AFIR/Mobilithek or public direct-payment pricing at station/EVSE scope. Never attach one DE*MSU network fallback.

deferred.missing: DE*GCE is attributable to Volkswagen Group Charging/Elli in roaming/operator directories and public station records, but many dealer/legacy sites expose no direct price and some require registration. Third-party apps show 0.80 EUR/kWh on examples, but that is insufficient to establish the exact direct CPO tariff or universal scope and is not promoted.
deferred.unblock: A primary Elli/Volkswagen direct-payment tariff by EVSE, reproducible DE*GCE QR/direct-payment payload, or AFIR/Mobilithek feed containing exact direct price components for the relevant EVSE.

aliasesResolved: DE*MSU -> msu solutions shared technical prefix; physical operator must remain EVSE-scoped
